comparison.objective: Insert a stripped cable into a lug, actuate a bench crimp press, remove it, and return it to its rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial conductor insertion, press actuation, and post-process extraction/placement.
comparison.success_condition: Conductor inserted to depth, crimp completed and released, cable removed and returned; real trial additionally requires a 450 N pull test.
comparison.reason: Both alter a small metal component using a tool, but crimping permanently compresses a lug around an inserted cable. The candidate instead fractures a sacrificial tang by impact while preserving the surrounding coil and must contain each fragment.
